## Status

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | ObservedGeneration tracks the spec generation this status reflects. |
| `readyReplicas` | integer | ReadyReplicas is the number of ready pods observed in the deployment. |
| `url` | string | URL is the in-cluster URL for the control plane service. |
| `operatorTokenSecretRef` | [SecretKeySelector](#secretkeyselector) | OperatorTokenSecretRef points to the Secret key containing the `coder-k8s-operator` API token. |
| `operatorTokenDatabaseHash` | string | OperatorTokenDatabaseHash is the SHA-256 hex hash of the PostgreSQL connection URL, without its password, with which the operator created the token in OperatorTokenSecretRef. The operator deletes that token only while the control plane uses a URL with the same hash. It is empty when that URL is not a postgres:// or postgresql:// URL. |
| `operatorAccessReady` | boolean | OperatorAccessReady reports whether operator API access bootstrap succeeded. |
| `licenseLastApplied` | [Time](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.35/#time-v1-meta) | LicenseLastApplied is the timestamp of the most recent successful operator-managed license upload. |
| `licenseLastAppliedHash` | string | LicenseLastAppliedHash is the SHA-256 hex hash of the trimmed license JWT that LicenseLastApplied refers to. |
| `licenseTier` | string | LicenseTier is a best-effort classification of the currently applied license. Values: none, trial, enterprise, premium, unknown. |
| `entitlementsLastChecked` | [Time](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.35/#time-v1-meta) | EntitlementsLastChecked is when the operator last queried coderd entitlements. |
| `externalProvisionerDaemonsEntitlement` | string | ExternalProvisionerDaemonsEntitlement is the entitlement value for feature "external_provisioner_daemons". Values: entitled, grace_period, not_entitled, unknown. |

## Referenced types

### AIGatewaySpec

AIGatewaySpec configures CoderAIGatewayKey objects that use a
CoderControlPlane (CoderControlPlane.spec.aiGateway).

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowKeys` | boolean | AllowKeys lets CoderAIGatewayKey objects in this namespace create and rotate Coder AI Gateway keys with this control plane's operator token. A gateway key lets its holder load the API key of every enabled AI provider, so this delegates that power to everyone who can create CoderAIGatewayKey objects here. When false (the default), the controller creates no key. Setting it back to false stops new keys and rotations. The current key of each CoderAIGatewayKey stays until that object is deleted. |

### DatabaseSpec

DatabaseSpec configures the external PostgreSQL database used by Coder.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connectionSecretRef` | [SecretKeySelector](#secretkeyselector) | ConnectionSecretRef references a key in a Secret in the CoderControlPlane's namespace. The value must be a postgres:// or postgresql:// connection URL. The controller injects it into the Coder container as CODER_PG_CONNECTION_URL through a Secret reference and uses it for operator access bootstrap. Running pods keep the old value after the Secret changes; restart the Deployment after rotating credentials. |

### MCPServersSpec

MCPServersSpec configures CoderMCPServer objects that use a
CoderControlPlane (CoderControlPlane.spec.mcpServers).

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `organizations` | string array | Organizations are the names of the Coder organizations whose MCP server configs CoderMCPServer objects can create, change and delete with this control plane's operator token. This delegates Coder organization-admin power over MCP servers in these organizations to everyone who can create CoderMCPServer objects here. A CoderMCPServer for an organization outside this list creates and changes nothing. Removing an organization disables in Coder each server config that a CoderMCPServer created there, with one request that holds only enabled: false, and then changes nothing else. After the organization is listed again, a spec edit enables the server. Deleting a CoderMCPServer still deletes the config it created. |
| `allowForceOn` | boolean | AllowForceOn lets CoderMCPServer objects use availability: force_on, which adds a server to every new chat of each user who can read it, without that user's choice. When false (the default), such objects create and change nothing, and a server config that one of them created is disabled in Coder, as for a removed organization. |

### TemplateTestsSpec

TemplateTestsSpec configures CoderTemplateTest runs against a control plane.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ownerUserID` | string | OwnerUserID is the UUID of the Coder user that owns every test workspace. Use a dedicated low-privilege tester user: each start build gives the owner's API token to the template's Terraform. Tests stay pending until this is set. |
| `allowRetain` | boolean | AllowRetain lets the annotation coder.com/deletion-policy: retain on a CoderTemplateTest release the test without deleting its workspace. This delegates that power to everyone who can create tests against this control plane: they can leave workspaces, and their owner's session keys, in Coder. When false (the default), the controller ignores retain and deletes the workspace. |

### WorkspacePoolOwner

WorkspacePoolOwner allows one Coder user as the owner of pool workspaces.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `userID` | string | UserID is the UUID of the Coder user, in lower case with hyphens, as Coder writes it. One user has one spelling, so the list holds each owner once. Coder's prebuilds system user is refused: Coder's prebuild reconciler can delete or hand out the workspaces it owns. |
| `templates` | string array | Templates are the only Coder templates, as `<organization>.<template>`, that pools of this owner can build. |
| `maxWorkspaces` | integer | MaxWorkspaces caps the workspaces of this owner across all pools of this control plane: unclaimed, bound, and used. |
